description: Telemetry sink admin (D22): mint ONE per-(runId, role) ingest token SEALED to the role's services x25519 public key. Output is ciphertext only ({runId, role, sealed}); plaintext ingest minting is impossible through this document (sealTo is required). Sink admin only: role clockchain-telemetry-sink-admin.

runId.description: Run UUID / id from the harness plan

sealTo.description: 0x + 64 lowercase hex: the role's services x25519 PUBLIC key (services-pub.txt on that role's host)

runCommand: OUT=$(docker exec "$CID" node dist/mint-cli.js ingest --runId '{{runId}}' --role '{{role}}' --seal-to '{{sealTo}}') || { echo 'mint refused (see stderr)' >&2; exit 65; }
printf '%s' "$OUT" | jq -ce 'if has("token") then error("plaintext token in mint output - refused") else {runId: .record.runId, role: .record.role, sealed: .sealed} end | select(.sealed != null)'
